title: When the Asset Wakes
author: Ansel Amberdale
blurb: Dominic Eriksen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
